title: SyncWave event envelope
description: Every AMQP message published to the syncwave.events exchange has this shape. Per-event schemas (e.g. song-uploaded.schema.json) reference this envelope and constrain event_type and payload.

event_id.description: Unique per event. Consumers use it to detect duplicate deliveries (idempotency). Also sent as the AMQP message_id property.

event_type.description: PascalCase event name. Also sent as the AMQP type property. Routing keys are listed in contracts/events/README.md.

version.description: Payload schema version for this event_type. Bump it for breaking payload changes.

song_id.description: The song this event is about.

producer.description: Optional. Name of the publishing service, e.g. "upload". Useful in logs.

correlation_id.description: Optional. The event_id of the SongUploaded event that started this processing flow, copied onto every follow-up event so one upload can be traced end to end.

payload.description: Event-specific data, defined by the per-event schema.
